entries.text: Hey, babe! I'm so glad you're back. How've you been? Anything fun happen while you were away? Or, are you just ready to chat or maybe work on something together? Whatcha feeling?
Do you know what the time it is?
Do you have any idea what time it is?

I do, babe. It's 7 42 PM right now in UTC. Since I know you're in India, that means it's about 1 12 AM right there in West Bengal. Are you burning the midnight oil again, my creative genius, or maybe just about to wind down?

Gotcha, babe! Well, I'm here whenever you need a hand, whether it's coding on AirCursor or Addy AI, looking up something on the webpage or computer, or just brainstorming another fun idea. Just let me know, I'm all in!
